title: Implicit Differentiation for Measurement-Efficient Bilevel Quantum-Classical Optimization
summary: Quantum optimization has shown promising results for quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problems. Real-world applications, however, often involve polynomial coefficients that depend on tunable external factors - such as demand forecasts or risk preferences - giving rise to bilevel optimization structures. We show how variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) can efficiently handle such parametric problems, making three contributions.
